title: List of Recommended Hotels Available
description: Archived hotel update for the Portland 2013 OpenStack Summit, linking to accommodation information after the event’s room blocks sold out.
body: Update: Our room blocks have sold out.  Please click here for a list of recommended hotels to reserve your room.  We look forward to seeing you in Portland!
